changes.beforeEn: Ready to tile does not mean the completed shower is ready for water or the floor is ready for traffic. We confirm likely downtime before work and provide project-specific handover instructions. changes.beforeEn: The laundry floor waste junction, where present, must be considered with surrounding falls, pipe penetrations and the wet area floor wall junction. We assess whether the existing base can support the selected system and how the work joins retained surfaces. Confirm who moves, disconnects and reinstates the washing machine, dryer or tub before work starts. The written quote separates removal and preparation from membrane work and the final tiled finish; concealed damage can change that scope after exposure.
changes.beforeZh: 已有地漏需结合周边坡度、管线穿透点及湿区墙地交接评估。我们检查现有基层能否支持所选系统及如何连接保留表面。开工前确认谁搬动、断开及复装洗衣机、烘干机或洗衣槽。报价分别列出拆除准备、膜层与最终贴砖；打开后发现的隐蔽损坏可能改变范围。
changes.afterEn: We assess any floor waste together with the surrounding falls, pipe penetrations and wall-floor junctions. We check the base and how the selected system joins retained surfaces, then agree who moves, disconnects and reinstates appliances or the tub. The written quote separates removal and preparation, membrane work and tiling; additional damage found after opening is discussed before the scope changes.
changes.afterZh: 我们结合已有地漏、周边坡度、管线穿透点和墙地交接进行评估。检查基层及所选系统与保留表面的衔接，再落实设备或洗衣槽的搬动、断开和复装责任。书面报价分别列明拆除准备、防水与贴砖；打开后发现额外损坏，会先沟通再调整范围。
changes.basis: 沿用本页已说明的服务范围与流程，不新增包含项目或时间承诺

changes.beforeEn: Water-retaining surfaces face continuous immersion, which differs from rain exposure on a terrace or occasional splashing beside a pool. A proposed membrane and finish must be suitable together for the existing pool surface and intended exposure. We assess compatibility with the existing surface before selecting materials and defining the installation. Pool surround photographs show external tiled work and do not document an internal membrane installation.
changes.beforeZh: 蓄水表面持续浸水，与露台淋雨或池边偶尔溅水不同。拟定膜层与饰面需共同适合现有池体表面和暴露条件。选择材料及明确安装前先评估兼容性。泳池周边照片展示室外铺砖，未记录池体内部膜层安装。
changes.afterEn: We select the membrane and finish together for the pool lining and continuous water exposure. We assess the existing surface and junctions before specifying preparation and installation. Pool-interior work has its own quoted scope, separate from the external coping and terrace finish.
changes.afterZh: 我们根据泳池内衬及持续浸水条件配套选择防水膜和饰面。明确基层处理与安装前，先评估现有表面及交接。池内工作单独列明报价范围，与室外池沿压顶及露台饰面区分。
changes.basis: 沿用本页浸水兼容性和内外分工，不再用外部照片是否构成证明的审计口吻
changes.promiseChange: 不扩大；保留原范围、条件及费用责任

changes.beforeEn: We agree the accessible work area, surface preparation and how any selected protective system meets surrounding finishes. Elevated or concealed areas require access arrangements before findings can be confirmed. This scope does not assume below-ground structures, retaining walls or structural repairs are included. Where the source or base needs another investigation or trade, that boundary is recorded before work proceeds. Colour and texture matching to an existing external finish are discussed rather than promised.
changes.beforeZh: 确认可接触施工区、基层准备，以及选定防护系统与周边饰面衔接。高处或隐蔽区域需先安排通行才能确认发现。本范围不自动包含地下构造、挡土墙或结构维修；需其他调查或工种时，施工前记录边界。现有外墙色彩与纹理匹配会先讨论，不作完全一致承诺。
changes.afterEn: We define the work area, surface preparation and connections to surrounding finishes in your quote. We arrange access before assessing elevated or concealed areas and identify any separate investigation or trade work. Below-ground structures, retaining walls and structural repairs require their own scope. We discuss the expected colour and texture match before treating the wall.
changes.afterZh: 我们在报价中明确施工区、基层处理及与周边饰面的衔接。高处或隐蔽区域先安排通行，再进行评估，并列明需要的独立调查或其他工种。地下构造、挡土墙及结构维修需单独明确范围；墙面处理前会沟通预期颜色与纹理匹配效果。
changes.basis: 沿用本页已说明的服务范围与流程，不新增包含项目或时间承诺
changes.promiseChange: 不扩大；保留原范围、条件及费用责任

changes.beforeEn: Even a small damp area needs a defined boundary. We consider substrate preparation, adjoining dry surfaces, penetrations and any finish to be retained. A local patch is only proposed where the existing material and junctions can support the agreed treatment. Pool interiors use our separate pool waterproofing service; specialist commercial systems and structural repairs need their own scope. If the space belongs to a named service, we use that service scope rather than duplicate an unrelated whole-property programme.
changes.beforeZh: 小范围受潮也需明确边界。应考虑基层准备、相邻干区、穿透点及保留饰面。只有现有材料和交接支持处理时才建议局部补片。泳池内部使用独立泳池防水服务，专业商业系统或结构维修另定范围。空间属于已有服务时，按相应范围处理，不重复套用无关整屋工程。
changes.afterEn: We define the repair area and assess the base, adjoining dry surfaces, penetrations and retained finishes. We propose a local repair where the existing material and junctions support it. Pool interiors use our separate pool waterproofing service; specialist commercial systems and structural repairs require their own scope. We use the relevant room service when it fits your project.
changes.afterZh: 我们明确维修区域，评估基层、相邻干区、穿透点及保留饰面。现有材料和交接适合时，安排局部修复。泳池内部按独立泳池防水服务处理；专业商业系统及结构维修需单独明确范围。项目属于已有房间服务时，采用对应服务流程。
changes.basis: 沿用本页已说明的服务范围与流程，不新增包含项目或时间承诺
changes.promiseChange: 不扩大；保留原范围、条件及费用责任

changes.beforeEn: The tile thickness, adhesive bed and preparation affect the finished height at a door. We consider the available threshold, drainage direction and outlet access together before agreeing the finish. Coping and exposed edges also need a defined termination. Weather exposure and material curing affect access restrictions; the quote confirms the sequence rather than guaranteeing a fixed turnaround.
changes.beforeZh: 砖厚、胶层和准备影响门口完成面高度。确定饰面前，一起考虑门槛可用高度、排水方向及排水口通行。压顶和外露边缘也需明确终止做法。天气和材料养护影响使用限制；报价确认顺序，不保证固定周转时间。
changes.afterEn: We plan the finished doorway height using the tile thickness, adhesive bed and required base preparation. We assess the threshold, drainage direction and outlet access together, and define the coping and exposed edge details. Your quote sets out the sequence and expected access restrictions, allowing for weather and material curing.
changes.afterZh: 我们结合砖厚、胶层和基层准备，规划门口完成面高度。一并评估门槛、排水方向及排水口的可维护性，明确压顶与外露边缘做法。报价说明工序和预计使用限制，并考虑天气与材料养护。
changes.basis: 沿用本页已说明的服务范围与流程，不新增包含项目或时间承诺
changes.promiseChange: 不扩大；保留原范围、条件及费用责任

changes.beforeEn: This service is for wall and floor areas not covered by the named room options, such as an entry or a utility space. Describe the area and how it is used so we can determine whether installation, a small replacement or joint renewal fits the job. It is an assessment route for an unlisted space, rather than a promise of specialist stonework, structural repair or pool-interior capability.
changes.beforeZh: 针对未被具体房间选项覆盖的墙地面，例如入口或功能空间。说明区域用途，以判断适合安装、小范围更换还是接缝更新。这是未列空间的评估入口，并非承诺专业石材、结构维修或泳池内部施工能力。
changes.afterEn: We install and repair tiles in entries, utility spaces and other small wall or floor areas. Tell us how you use the space so we can assess installation, local replacement or joint renewal. Specialist stonework and structural repairs require a separate scope; pool-interior enquiries follow our pool waterproofing service.
changes.afterZh: 我们承接入口、功能空间及其他小面积墙地面的贴砖与维修。请说明空间用途，我们会评估安装、局部更换或接缝更新。专业石材和结构维修需单独明确范围；泳池内部需求按泳池防水服务处理。

changes.beforeEn: Missing or deteriorated grout can leave a tiled surface difficult to maintain. Ellis assesses the joints and surrounding tiles before agreeing regrouting for the affected wall or floor area. Loose tiles, movement or moisture damage may need separate repairs rather than simply new grout over the visible problem.
changes.beforeZh: 缺失或劣化填缝让砖面难以保养。Ellis 先评估接缝与周边瓷砖，再确认墙地面填缝更新。松砖、位移或水损坏可能需独立维修，不能只在可见问题上覆新填缝。
changes.afterEn: Missing or deteriorated grout can make tiled surfaces harder to clean and maintain. We assess the joints and surrounding tiles, then define the regrouting area. If tiles are loose or there is movement or moisture damage, we explain the repairs needed before renewing the grout.
changes.afterZh: 填缝缺失或老化，会让瓷砖表面更难清洁与保养。我们检查接缝和周边瓷砖，再明确重新填缝的区域。如发现松砖、位移或受潮损坏，会先说明所需维修，再更新填缝。
changes.basis: 沿用本页已说明的服务范围与流程，不新增包含项目或时间承诺
changes.promiseChange: 不扩大；保留原范围、条件及费用责任

changes.beforeEn: Wet walking surfaces need material suitability considered through the selected product information and intended use. Appearance alone does not establish slip resistance. We plan surface drainage, movement junctions and exposed edges together, with cleaning and care requirements explained at handover. For an enquiry about water-retaining surfaces, confirm the separate pool waterproofing scope before assuming it is included.
changes.beforeZh: 潮湿步行面需按产品资料和用途评估材料，外观不能证明防滑性。排水、伸缩交接和外露边缘整体规划，交付时解释清洁保养。咨询蓄水表面时，应先确认独立泳池防水范围，不能假定已包含。
changes.afterEn: We check the selected tile information for wet walking areas and plan drainage, movement joints and exposed edges together. Appearance alone does not establish slip resistance. At handover, we explain cleaning and care for the installed finish. Pool-interior waterproofing is assessed and quoted separately from the surround work.
changes.afterZh: 我们核对瓷砖产品资料，评估其是否适合潮湿步行区，并一并规划排水、伸缩接缝及外露边缘。外观本身不能证明防滑性能。交付时说明所用饰面的清洁与保养；泳池内部防水与周边贴砖分开评估和报价。
changes.basis: 沿用本页已说明的服务范围与流程，不新增包含项目或时间承诺
